g.text: Bachelor of Computing Systems (Level 7) — Toi Ohomai Institute of Technology

text.tspan: Cloud-based AI assistants like ChatGPT and Copilot require
sending personal data to external servers. Users have no
control over data retention, face subscription costs, and
cannot use AI tools offline. Existing local alternatives
offer basic chat but lack real desktop agency — they
cannot manage files, automate workflows, or execute tools.
HomeBot is a privacy-first desktop AI assistant that runs
entirely on the user's machine. It uses Ollama for local
LLM inference, providing 85+ tool handlers for file
management, web search, image generation, document
indexing, and workflow automation — all without sending
data to third-party services.
85+ tool handlers across 27 modules. The LLM
autonomously chains tools for multi-step
requests with a safety cap of 10 rounds.
File, web, system, vision, browser, API tools.
All processing runs locally via Ollama. No data
leaves the device unless the user explicitly
enables a cloud provider. 9-layer security
model with SSRF, IPC, and permission gating.
One-click deployment of n8n workflows from
the Automation Center. Webhook triggers,
Ollama integration, and response formatting.
Runs in Docker alongside Qdrant vector DB.
Drag-and-drop PDF, DOCX, code, and CSV
indexing with hybrid TF-IDF + semantic search.
Export conversations as Markdown, DOCX, or
PDF. Study Buddy quiz mode from documents.
Image generation across 5 backends (SD,
ComfyUI, DALL-E 3, Pollinations, Stable Horde).
Vision/OCR via moondream. Screen capture.
Voice I/O with Windows SAPI offline STT.
Electron 28 with glass-morphism UI theme.
Responsive layout from 500px to widescreen.
Morning briefing, global hotkey, auto-update,
conversation sidebar, analytics dashboard.

g.text: HomeBot demonstrates that a fully functional, privacy-first desktop AI assistant can operate with zero cloud dependency.
It combines local LLM inference, agentic tool execution, workflow automation, and a 9-layer security model in a single native application.
Electron · React · TypeScript · Ollama · n8n · Docker · Qdrant · Jest · Playwright
